segments.he: עֶרֶב תִּשְׁעָה בְּאָב לֹא יֹאכַל אָדָם שְׁנֵי תַבְשִׁילִין כּוּ׳. אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא מִשֵּׁשׁ שָׁעוֹת וּלְמַעְלָה, אֲבָל מִשֵּׁשׁ שָׁעוֹת וּלְמַטָּה — מוּתָּר. וְאָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא בִּסְעוּדָה הַמַּפְסִיק בָּהּ, אֲבָל בִּסְעוּדָה שֶׁאֵינוֹ מַפְסִיק בָּהּ — מוּתָּר.
segments.en: § The mishna taught: On «the eve of the Ninth of Av, a person may not eat two cooked dishes» in one meal. «Rav Yehuda said: They taught» that one may not partake of a meal with two dishes «only from six hours» of the day «and onward,» but «from six hours and earlier» it is «permitted. And Rav Yehuda» also «said: They taught» that it is prohibited to eat two dishes «only in the concluding meal» before beginning the fast. «However, in a non-concluding meal» it is «permitted» to eat two cooked dishes.
